Hello people! One of the features I miss from reddit is the ability to see your top comments (by day, month, all time, etc) but I'm aware that such a thing is very low priority for Voat right now. So I went ahead and made a little Greasemonkey script to do this for me. What it does is when you go to your comments page ( https://www.voat.co/user/yourusername/comments ) it will fetch comments from the next pages and organize everything in descending order so you can see the top comments in a single page!

To install the script just go to your Greasemonkey menu and select "New user script" and paste the code below. Chrome allows you to add an user-script too but I'm too lazy to search exactly how to do it right now, but go ahead and look if you want to try. I've done it before and it's almost as simple.

Be conscious that this will load more pages than usual from Voat's servers! You don't want to keep this script active all of the time to prevent loading a ton of pages and overloading Voat more than you should so either use it wisely or disable it after using, through the Greasemonkey menu!

If you know what you're doing and take responsibility of not overloading Voat unnecesserily or constantly you could also bump EXTRAPAGES to a higher number, to reach further into the past. Please be mindful when doing this, Voat is expecting you to only load 1 page per time. This is meant as a temporary work-around, if you really wanna see all of your top comments wait for Voat to add this function officially to the site.

// ==UserScript==
// @name voat.co - top comments
// @namespace omegletrollz
// @include http*://*voat.co/user/*/comments
// @version 1
// @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest
// ==/UserScript==
var EXTRAPAGES=5;
var pool=[];
var hits=0;
function clean(comment,classname){
 return Number(comment.querySelector(classname).innerHTML[1]);
}
function fetch(dom){
 var parent=dom.querySelector('.content-no-margin');
 var comments=dom.querySelectorAll('.comment');
 for(var i=0;i<comments.length;i++){
 var c=comments[i];
 pool[pool.length]=[clean(c,'.post_upvotes')/(1+clean(c,'.post_upvotes')),c];
 parent.removeChild(c);
 }
}
function done(){
 pool.sort(function(a,b){
 return b[0]-a[0];
 })
 var parent=document.querySelector('.content-no-margin');
 var before=parent.childNodes[parent.childNodes.length-2];
 for(var i=0;i<pool.length;i++){
 //alert(pool[i][1].innerHTML);
 parent.insertBefore(pool[i][1],before);
 }
}
fetch(document.body);
var parent=document.querySelector('.content-no-margin');
var loading=document.createElement('div');
loading.innerHTML='Loading... 0%';
parent.insertBefore(loading,parent.childNodes[2]);
for(var i=1;i<=EXTRAPAGES;i++){
 GM_xmlhttpRequest({
 method: "GET",
 url: document.location.href+'?page='+i,
 onload: function(response) {
 fetch(new DOMParser()
 .parseFromString(response.responseText, "text/html"));
 hits+=1;
 loading.innerHTML='Loading... '+Math.round(100*hits/EXTRAPAGES)+'%';
 if(hits==EXTRAPAGES){
 loading.innerHTML='';
 done();
 }
 }
 });
}
